description: One-dimensional tolerance stack-up (worst-case and RSS) — Computes the minimum and maximum of a linear dimensional stack (the gap) from signed contributions with symmetric, unequal-bilateral, unilateral or min/max limits, both by exact worst-case arithmetic and by root-sum-square, names the dominant contributor and tests the gap against a required minimum and/or maximum. For mechanical designers and agents checking clearances. It does not do 2D or 3D sta

dimensions.description: At most 100. Give nominal with tol, or nominal with plus and/or minus (unilateral: one of them), or min and max.

max.description: Largest allowed size (limits form, with min).

min.description: Smallest allowed size (limits form, with max).

sign.description: +1 adds the dimension to the gap (default), -1 subtracts it.

method.description: Which result decides status against the requirement (default worst-case). Both are always reported.

reportSigma.description: RSS: report the gap at this many sigma (default equals sigmaLevel).

max.description: Gap must be at most this.

min.description: Gap must be at least this.

sigmaLevel.description: RSS: each tolerance is this many sigma (default 3).

unit.description: Label for the single unit all numbers share (not converted).

name: tolerance-stack
